note: How the red and green lines' stations are laid out, for tools/build-stations.ts (see there for the format). Each is read from Albert Guillaumes' drawing of the station (estacions.albertguillaumes.cat, used as a reference only), with its exits at OpenStreetMap's subway entrances. T-Centralen, Odenplan and Fridhemsplan aren't here: they are his 3D models (public/data/stations.json).

Östermalmstorg.note: Two platform halls, one for each track, joined at both ends and in the middle. From the south-west end, escalators climb in two flights to a long ticket hall under Stureplan with four exits; from the north-east end, two flights to the hall at Sibyllegatan and Nybrogatan.

Gamla stan.note: Two island platforms at ground level, a metre or two above the streets beside them, red on the inner side of each and green on the outer. Stairs go down through each platform to the ticket hall under the tracks, and up from it to the streets.

Slussen.note: Two island platforms, red on the inner side of each and green on the outer. Stairs up from each platform to the hall over the tracks, at street level by Ryssgården.

Mariatorget.note: Two platform halls, one for each track, joined at both ends and in the middle. Escalators climb from each end to a ticket hall, and stairs to the street.

Zinkensdamm.note: Two platform halls, one for each track, joined in the middle. From there stairs and an escalator climb over the southern hall to the ticket hall.

Hornstull.note: Two platform halls, one for each track, joined at both ends and in the middle. From the west end, escalators and stairs climb to a ticket hall with exits round Hornstull; from the east end, a long flight to Långholmsgatan.

Liljeholmen.note: Three tracks in a concrete box under the bus terminal. Stairs climb from both platforms to a hall across the tracks at the north-east end, by the shopping centre.

Karlaplan.note: An island platform deep in the rock. Escalators climb from each end of it to a ticket hall: Valhallavägen to the north-east, Karlaplan to the south-west.

Gärdet.note: Two platform halls, one for each track, joined at both ends and in the middle. Escalators climb from the south-west end to Brantingsgatan; from the north-east end, escalators and stairs climb over the eastern hall to a ticket hall, with lifts up to the hill above and a long passage out to Tegeluddsvägen.

Ropsten.note: The line's northern end, on a bridge over Hjorthagen's shore: a wide platform between the tracks, under a roof. Stairs go down through it to the ticket hall on the ground beneath, by the Lidingö trams.

Stadion.note: An island platform, its rock left standing in two long pillars down the middle. From the north end a long flight climbs to a ticket hall under Valhallavägen with exits to both sides of it and to the Stadion; from the south end, escalators climb to Karlavägen.

Tekniska högskolan.note: A long island platform. Escalators climb from each end of it: to the south-east, a ticket hall under Valhallavägen with exits to the bus terminal and Roslagsbanan; to the north-west, one under Odengatan.

Universitetet.note: An island platform under the university's campus. Escalators climb from its south end to the ticket hall and the exit by Frescati.

Bergshamra.note: Two platform halls far apart, one for each track, joined by passages. From the northern one, escalators climb over the western hall to the ticket hall at Bergshamra torg.

Danderyds sjukhus.note: An island platform in a concrete box just under the ground. Escalators climb from each end to a ticket hall: by the hospital to the south, and to the bus terminal to the north.

Mörby centrum.note: The line's northern end: a wide island platform deep in the rock. Long escalators climb from it to the ticket hall under the shopping centre.

Midsommarkransen.note: Two platform halls far apart, one for each track, joined at the north-east end. From there escalators climb over each hall to an exit on either side of Svandammsvägen.

Telefonplan.note: An island platform in the open, narrowing to the east. At its west end stairs climb along it and over the northern track to the ticket hall.

Hägerstensåsen.note: An island platform in the open, its south-west end on a bridge. Stairs go down from that end to a ticket hall under the bridge, and up from the other end to one over the tracks.

Västertorp.note: A wide island platform in the open. Stairs go down from each end to a ticket hall under the tracks.

Fruängen.note: The end of T14: an island platform in the open. At its south end the ticket hall opens onto Fruängstorget, with stairs down to Fruängsplan.

Aspudden.note: An island platform in the rock. Escalators climb from its west end to the ticket hall at Hägerstensvägen.

Örnsberg.note: An island platform in the open. At its east end stairs climb to a ticket hall over the tracks, level with the street up the slope.

Axelsberg.note: An island platform in the open. At its east end stairs climb to a ticket hall over the tracks, level with Hägerstensvägen.

Mälarhöjden.note: An island platform deep in the hill. Escalators climb from its north-east end, and a long passage runs out through the hillside to the exit at its foot.

Bredäng.note: A long island platform, its east end on a bridge over the road. Stairs go down from there to the ticket hall under the bridge.

Sätra.note: Two platforms in a cutting, facing each other across a wide paved space. At the south end the ticket hall opens onto Sätra torg.

Skärholmen.note: An island platform in a concrete box under the centre. Escalators climb from it to two ticket halls: to Skärholmen centrum in the middle, and to the bus terminal at the east end.

Vårberg.note: An island platform in the open. At its west end stairs climb to a ticket hall over the tracks, level with the street. OpenStreetMap has no entrance mapped here.

Vårby gård.note: A wide island platform on a bank, its north end on a bridge. At its south end the ticket hall opens onto the street.

Masmo.note: A short island platform deep under the hill, at the foot of its slope. Escalators climb from it straight to the ticket hall.

Fittja.note: A wide island platform on a bank. At its north-east end the ticket hall opens onto Fittja centrum.

Alby.note: Two platform halls in the rock, one for each track, joined at the east end. From there escalators climb over the southern hall to the ticket hall by the bus terminal.

Hallunda.note: A wide island platform in the open. At its east end stairs climb to a ticket hall over the tracks, and stairs on up the hill to Hallunda centrum.

Norsborg.note: The end of T13: an island platform in the open. At its east end the ticket hall opens onto the street.

Hötorget.note: An island platform deep under Sveavägen, with three ticket halls: one over the middle of the platform, under the street at Hötorget, and one at each end.

Rådmansgatan.note: An island platform under Sveavägen. Escalators climb from each end to a ticket hall, each with exits to both sides of the street.

Sankt Eriksplan.note: An island platform in a concrete box under Sankt Eriksgatan. Escalators climb from each end to a ticket hall: three exits round Sankt Eriksplan to the south, one to the north.

Thorildsplan.note: An island platform in the open. At its east end stairs go down to a ticket hall under the tracks, with passages out to either side of the line.

Kristineberg.note: An island platform on a bank. At its west end stairs go down to the ticket hall at the street.

Alvik.note: Two side platforms, with the Nockebybanan's tracks between them. At their west end stairs go down from each to the ticket hall at Alviks torg; at the east end stairs climb from the northern one to Tranebergsvägen up the hill.

Stora mossen.note: An island platform in the open. At its east end stairs go down to the ticket hall under the tracks, with exits to either side.

Abrahamsberg.note: An island platform in the open. At its west end stairs go down to the ticket hall under the tracks.

Brommaplan.note: An island platform in the open. At its west end stairs go down to the ticket hall at Brommaplan.

Åkeshov.note: Two island platforms, with the track between them where the T17 turns. At their east end stairs go down from each to a passage under the tracks, with an exit on each side. (OpenStreetMap maps no entrance here.)

Ängbyplan.note: An island platform on a curve in the open. At its west end stairs go down to the ticket hall at the street. (OpenStreetMap maps no entrance here.)

Islandstorget.note: An island platform in a cutting. At its west end stairs climb to the ticket hall over the tracks, which opens onto the street up the slope by Islandstorget.

Blackeberg.note: An island platform in a cutting. At its north-west end stairs climb to a ticket hall over the tracks, with exits to Blackebergs torg and both sides of Vinjegatan.

Råcksta.note: An island platform in the open. At its north end stairs go down to the ticket hall under the tracks.

Vällingby.note: A wide island platform, its west end under the deck of Vällingby centrum. Escalators climb from that end to the ticket hall in the centre, with exits onto its squares; at the east end stairs go down to the street.

Johannelund.note: Two side platforms in the open. In the middle stairs go down from each to a passage under the tracks, which leads out to the north.

Hässelby gård.note: An island platform on a viaduct. At its west end stairs go down through the platform to the ticket hall under the tracks, at the street.

Hässelby strand.note: The western end of the line: a wide island platform in the open. At its west end stairs go down to the ticket hall under it, which opens onto the street below.

Medborgarplatsen.note: An island platform in a concrete box under Götgatan. In the middle stairs climb to an exit on Medborgarplatsen; from the south end escalators climb to a ticket hall with exits to both sides of the street.

Skanstull.note: An island platform in a concrete box under Götgatan, just north of the bridge. Escalators climb from the south end to a ticket hall with exits round Ringvägen; a long passage leads from the north end to Götgatan.

Gullmarsplan.note: Two island platforms where the line divides, their south end under the bus terminal's deck. From the south end of each, stairs climb to a ticket hall over the tracks, which opens onto the terminal.

Skärmarbrink.note: Two island platforms where the Farsta and Skarpnäck branches part. From the south-east end of each, stairs climb to a bridge over the tracks, and down from it to the street.

Hammarbyhöjden.note: An island platform in the open. At its west end stairs go down to the ticket hall under the tracks.

Björkhagen.note: An island platform in the open. In the middle stairs go down to a passage under the tracks, with an exit on each side.

Kärrtorp.note: An island platform in the open. At its south end stairs go down to the ticket hall at the street.

Bagarmossen.note: An island platform in the rock, 19 m down. Long escalators climb from its north end to the ticket hall at Bagarmossen's centre.

Skarpnäck.note: The end of T17: an island platform in a cavern 25 m down, the tracks ending at buffers just past it. From its south end long escalators climb to a passage that leads to the ticket hall at Skarpnäcks allé.

Blåsut.note: An island platform in the open. At its south end stairs go down to the ticket hall under the tracks.

Sandsborg.note: An island platform in the open. At its south end stairs go down to the ticket hall under the tracks.

Skogskyrkogården.note: An island platform in the open, by the cemetery. At its north end stairs go down to the ticket hall at the street.

Tallkrogen.note: An island platform in the open. At its south-west end stairs go down to the ticket hall at the street.

Gubbängen.note: An island platform in a shallow cutting. At its south end stairs go down to a passage under the tracks, with an exit to the street beside the line.

Hökarängen.note: An island platform in the open. At each end stairs go down to a ticket hall under the tracks.

Farsta.note: A wide island platform on a viaduct by Farsta centrum. In the middle stairs go down to the ticket hall under the tracks, which opens onto the street on the west side.

Farsta strand.note: The end of T18: an island platform in a concrete box under the centre. In the middle stairs climb to the ticket hall at the street.

Globen.note: A wide island platform in a cutting. At its east end stairs climb to a ticket hall at the street, by the arena.

Enskede gård.note: An island platform in the open. At its north end stairs go down to the ticket hall under the tracks.

Sockenplan.note: An island platform in the open. At its north end stairs go down to the ticket hall at the street.

Svedmyra.note: An island platform, its north-east half on a bank over the street. In the middle stairs go down to the ticket hall under the tracks.

Stureby.note: An island platform in the open. At its west end stairs go down to a long passage under the tracks, out to the ticket hall at the street.

Bandhagen.note: An island platform in the open. At its south end stairs go down to a passage under the tracks, out to the street.

Högdalen.note: Two platforms either side of a middle track, which isn't drawn: the platforms are joined across it. At the south end the platform leads out to the ticket hall at the street.

Rågsved.note: An island platform in the open. At its south-west end stairs go down to the ticket hall under the tracks.

Hagsätra.note: The end of T19: a wide island platform in the open. At its south end stairs go down to the ticket hall under the tracks.

Kungsträdgården.note: The end of the blue line, 34 m down: two platform halls in one great cavern, one for each track, joined at both ends and in the middle. From the west end, escalators climb in two flights to the ticket hall under Jakobsgatan; from the east end, two flights to the hall in Kungsträdgården park.

Rådhuset.note: Two platform halls in the rock under Kungsholmen, one for each track, joined at both ends and in the middle. From the west end, escalators climb in two flights to a ticket hall with exits on Hantverkargatan and Kungsholmsgatan; from the east end, two flights and a long passage to Kungsholmsgatan.

Stadshagen.note: Two platform halls, one for each track, joined at both ends and in the middle. From the south-east end, escalators climb to the ticket hall at Kellgrensgatan and the sports ground; from the north-west end, to Mariedalsvägen.

Västra skogen.note: Where the line splits for Hjulsta and Akalla: three tracks in the rock, the trains into town on the two eastern ones, beside two platform halls joined at both ends and in the middle; the trains out of town on the western track, beside its own platform, reached by stairs and a footbridge over the tracks. From the south end, escalators climb 7 m, then the metro's longest, 66 m and 33 m high, to the one exit.

Huvudsta.note: An island platform in the rock, 25 m down. Escalators climb in two flights from its west end to the ticket hall at Huvudsta centrum.

Solna strand.note: An island platform in the rock, 28 m down. Escalators climb from its north end to the ticket hall at Solna strand.

Sundbybergs centrum.note: An island platform in the rock, 26 m down. From its south end escalators climb to a ticket hall with exits round Sundbyberg's centre; from the north end, to Prästgårdsgatan.

Duvbo.note: An island platform in the rock, 20–35 m down. From its south-east end escalators climb in two flights to the ticket hall at Duvbo.

Rissne.note: Two platforms in the rock, side by side between the tracks, joined along their middle. Escalators climb between them to the ticket hall at Rissne's centre.

Rinkeby.note: Two platforms in the rock, each outside its track, with the link to Rissnedepån between them (not drawn). From the south-east end of each, escalators climb over the tracks to a landing, and on to the ticket hall at Rinkebytorget.

Tensta.note: An island platform in the rock, 20–22 m down. Escalators climb from both ends: to the ticket hall at Tensta centrum in the east, and to Hjulstavägen in the west.

Hjulsta.note: The end of T10: an island platform in the rock under Hjulstaskolan, the tracks running on beyond it. From its south-east end escalators climb to a landing, and a passage leads over the tracks to the ticket hall at Hjulsta torg.

Solna centrum.note: Two platform halls in the rock under Skytteholmsparken, 27–36 m down, one for each track, joined at both ends and in the middle. From the middle, escalators climb south to the ticket hall at Centralvägen and the bus terminal; from the north end, to the hall at the shopping centre.

Näckrosen.note: Two platform halls in the rock under the old film studios, 21 m down, one for each track, joined at both ends and in the middle. Escalators climb from both ends: to Storskogstorget in Sundbyberg in the north, and to Råsundavägen in Solna in the south.

Hallonbergen.note: An island platform in the rock, 28 m down; a third track beside it, which the trains use only to and from Rissnedepån, isn't drawn. From its north-west end escalators climb to the ticket hall at Hallonbergen's centre.

Kista.note: The only station of the blue line in the open: a wide island platform on Kistaviadukten. From its north end stairs go down to the ticket hall under the viaduct, at the bus terminal.

Husby.note: An island platform in the rock under Husby centrum. Escalators climb in two flights from both ends, to the ticket halls at Trondheimsgatan in the south and Bergengatan in the north.

Akalla.note: The end of T11: two platform halls in the rock, 20 m down, one for each track, joined at both ends and in the middle. From the north-west end, escalators climb to the ticket hall at Akalla torg and its underground bus terminal; from the south-east end, to Sibeliusgången.
